content: Samson oh Serepein en Timna men
Samson eri kohdihla Timna, wasa e kilangada ie serepein en Pilisdia men.
E ahpw pwurala ni imweo oh ndaiong eh pahpa oh nohno, “I kilangadahr serepein en Pilisdia men nan Timna. Kumwa kohla kahrehdo, pwe I men pwoudiki.”

A eh pahpa oh nohno ndaiong, “Dahme ke pahn kolahng pwoudikihki lihen Pilisdia rotorot akan? Ke sohte kak diar omw pwoud rehn kisehmw kan de rehn atail peneinei kan?” A Samson ndaiong eh pahpao, “Ihete me I men pwoudiki, pwe I poakepoake.”

Seme oh ineo sehse me KAUN-O me ketin kakahluwa Samson pwe en wiahda met, pwe KAUN-O ketin raparapahki ahnsou mwahu en mahweniong mehn Pilisdia kan. Pwe ni ahnsowo mehn Pilisdia kan me kakaun mehn Israel.
Samson eri iang seme oh ineo kohdihla Timna. Ni ar kohkohdilahng Timna, limwahn mwetin wain ehu, Samson ahpw rongada laion emen me weriwer.
Eri, manaman en KAUN-O ahpw kakehlailihada Samson, ih eri uhdahte poarohng laiono dapengpeseng, rasehng kisin kuht kis. E ahpw sohte mweseiseikihong seme oh ineo dahme e wiao.
Mwuhr, e ahpw kohla oh lokaiaiong serepein me e poakepoakeo.

Kedekedeo, Samson pil pwurala pwe en pwoudikihda serepeino. E ahpw wetla sang nanialo pwe en kilang laion me e kemehlao. E ahpw pwuriamweikihla eh kilangada mwuten loangalap ehu oh pil sukehn loangalap nan paliweren laiono.

E ahpw deukadahng nan peh sukehn loangalap ko oh kangkang kohla. Ih eri kohla oh kihong ekis kenen semeo oh ineo. Ira ahpw iang tungoale, a Samson sohte padahkihong ira me e kihsang nan kahlap en mahno.
Semeo pil iang kohla ni imwen serepeino, wasa Samson wiahda kamadipw ehu. Pwe ih duwen tiahk en sahpwo ong mwahnakapw en wasao.
Ni mehn Pilisdia ko ar kilangada, re ahpw kahredohng reh mwahnakapw 30 pwe re en kin mihmi reh.

Samson eri ndaiong irail, “I pahn wiahiong kumwail kahk ehu. Ma kumwail pahn diarada wehwe mwohn imwiseklahn rahn isuhwen kamadipw en kapwopwoud wet, a I pahn kihong kumwail lepin likou linen kaselel 30 oh likou reirei kaselel 30. A ma kumwail sohte kak diarada, a kumwail pahn kihong ie lepin likou linen 30 oh likou reirei 30.” Irail eri sapeng, nda, “Nna, ndadohng kiht kahken. Se men rongadahr.”
Ih eri ndahng irail,

content.text: “Kisin tungoal kohda sang rehn me kin tungoalehla,
mehkot mem kohda sang rehn me kehlailo.”

content: Mwurin rahn siluh re sohte diarada wehwehn kahk wet.

Ni kapaheiun rahno re ndaiong en Samson eh pwoudo, “Pitih mahs omw pwoudo pwe en ndaiong kiht wehwehn kahk wet. Pwe ma soh, se pahn isikada imwen omw pahpao oh pil kowe. Kumwa seu lukeikitodohng kamadipw wet, pwe kumwa en kulihasang at kepwe kan?”

En Samson eh pwoudo eri kohla reh oh ndaiong, “Ke sohte poakepoake ie. Ke kailongkin ie. Pwe ke ndaiong kompoakepahi kan kahk ehu, ke ahpw sohte ndaiong ie ia wehwe.” Samson ahpw ndaiong, “Kilang! I pil sohte ndaiong ei pahpa oh nohno. A dahme I pahn ndakihong uhk?”
A serepeino wie sengisengki erein rahn isuhwen kamadipwo. A ni keisuhwen rahno, Samson ahpw kasalehiong. Serepeino eri kasalehiong kompoakepah ko.
Eri, ni keisuhwen rahno, mwohn Samson eh pahn meirla, mwahnakapw en kahnimwo ndaiong,
Samson eri sapengkin irail,

content.text: kumwail sohte pahn ese pasapengpen kahket.”

content: Eri, manaman en KAUN-O ahpw kakehlailihala, Samson ahpw kohdihla Askelon, wasa e kemehla ohl 30, kihsang ar likou kaselel kan oh kihong ohl ako me kihda pasapengpen eh kahko. Ih eri pwurala ni imweo.
En Samson eh pwoudo eri pwoudikihla mwahnakapwo me sounkadehde ara kapwopwoudo.
